mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II in the context of notable additive-manufacturing applications:

List-I
 a. OsteoForge
 b. IISc

List-II
 i. Photonic IC blocks
 ii. Silk-based implants

Codes:
mcqs.explanation: The correct matching is OsteoForge with silk-based implants and IISc with photonic IC blocks. The tempting option a-i, b-ii reverses these two applications.

mcqs.question: Which institution transmitted conventional data with entangled photons through the same 50-km optical fibre?
mcqs.explanation: IIT Delhi transmitted conventional data with entangled photons through the same 50-km optical fibre. IIT Gandhinagar, BISAG-N and QNu Labs were associated with the free-space Quantum Key Distribution link, not this 50-km optical-fibre transmission.
